item.title: Stanley Bauer
item.description: Stanley E. Bauer, age 90, of Lucinda, passed away suddenly on February 17, 2026. He was born in Lucinda on April 11, 1935, and was the son of the late Edward Bauer and Florence Griebel Bauer. Stan married Mary Rose Schupp of Lucinda on June 15, 1963, at St. Joseph’s Catholic Church in Lucinda. He graduated from Farmington High School ...
